title: Arbiter client calls
what: One call for every route of the master and the node arbiter, sending the route's body and reading its answer as the route's type, and the master's event stream read as events.

title: Card and ticket types
what: The node arbiter's card, its tickets and its card units as every route answers them, with the bodies and queries that ask for a turn, rest it and move a unit.

title: Cluster types
what: The cluster as the master pictures it: the master, groups, nodes with cards, units and queues, declared units, placed services, the placement under way and the last notes.

title: Unit description types
what: What a service says each of its units holds on a card: its blocks, its output layer, the MTP head and the full attention blocks of a store, by the unit's name.

title: Event types
what: The events the master publishes on its one stream, each named by its resource and its change, with the queries that narrow and resume it and the health route's answer.

title: Placement types
what: A service put on a node or taken off one: the request, the placement with its state and lines, and the kinds both routes take and answer.

title: Wire error and page
what: The one shape every failure and refusal is answered in, its codes, and the page every collection is answered as, as the wire format in docs/api.md states them.
